facts.fact: Chad's State report to the CRPD Committee says article 32 of Act No. 007/PR/2007 requires the State, local authorities and public and private bodies to work to adapt the environment and communication and information systems so persons with disabilities can access services.
facts.system: Act No. 007/PR/2007 on the protection of persons with disabilities

facts.fact: Chad's State report says Decree No. 1521/PR/MFPPESN/2019 (articles 21-22) requires public transport agencies to provide sign language support for hard-of-hearing persons and information in Braille for persons with visual impairments.
